name: piabyss
description: A desktop interface for Pi Coding Agent

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @piabyss/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @piabyss/pi-host run build && pnpm --filter @piabyss/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @piabyss/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @piabyss/protocol run typecheck && pnpm --filter @piabyss/pi-host run typecheck && pnpm --filter @piabyss/desktop run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @piabyss/protocol run build && pnpm -r --filter @piabyss/protocol --filter @piabyss/pi-host --filter @piabyss/desktop run test
scripts.test:rust: node scripts/prepare-rust-test-resources.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target-dir apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/verify-rust
scripts.verify:quick: pnpm verify:docs && pnpm verify:fixtures && pnpm verify:release-metadata && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.verify:p0: pnpm verify:quick && pnpm build && pnpm test:rust && pnpm lint:rust
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:js && pnpm lint:unused && pnpm format:check
scripts.lint:js: eslint eslint.config.mjs apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/vite.config.ts apps/desktop/vitest.config.ts packages/protocol/src packages/protocol/vitest.config.ts packages/pi-host/src packages/pi-host/vitest.config.ts scripts
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target-dir apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/verify-clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.format: prettier --write eslint.config.mjs apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/*.config.ts packages/*/src packages/*/*.config.ts scripts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github/workflows
